issues.reason: `(Member l_paul_bremer u_s)` puts the proper-noun individual `u_s` in a class position, which *Categorical statements* forbids outright ('an individual must never appear in a class position'), and the compound rule's 'a noun modifier is never exposed … leave those in the symbol' means 'U.S.' belongs inside a fused compound kind, not as a class Bremer instantiates.

'the northern cities of Erbil and Sulaimaniyah' is a definite plural with named members, which *Coordination & plurals* encodes as one group witness — `(GroupOf <g> city)` plus a `PartOf` per named member — whereas multiple same-role atoms on one event are licensed only as the collective multi-`Agent` form for a reciprocal/aggregate predicate.

Same defect as index 1 — the second conjunct is stacked as another `Goal` on the single visit event instead of joining the group witness, so the licensed group encoding is what the pair must be replaced by.

gaps_confirmed: sentence-initial discourse adverb 'Meanwhile' with no second clause in the text — no eventuality for a temporal relation to attach to and no licensed carrier for discourse-level simultaneity
support/light-verb construction over an event noun ('paid a two-hour visit to …') — the light-verb rule names only occur / happen / take place
new_gaps: a proper-noun modifier on a common-noun role head ('the U.S. administrator'): the compound rule prescribes fusion because a noun modifier is never exposed, but the naming section declares proper nouns outside the compound machinery, and the proper-noun component buried in the fused symbol then carries no `Name` atom of its own

a partitive-looking naming of-phrase that enumerates a definite plural's members ('the cities OF Erbil and Sulaimaniyah') — this is appositive identification, not the possessive, partitive or nominalization-object of-phrase the instruction set distinguishes
repair_summary: Replaced `(Past (Member l_paul_bremer u_s))` by fusing the noun modifier into the compound kind on the existing typing atom — `(Past (Member l_paul_bremer u_s_administrator))` plus its mandatory genus `(Inheritance u_s_administrator administrator)`; replaced the two stacked `Goal` atoms with one group witness `sk_cities_1` — `(GroupOf sk_cities_1 city)`, a single `(Goal sk_visit_1 sk_cities_1)`, and `PartOf` links for erbil and sulaimaniyah.
notes: The group route is what preserves the sentence's single two-hour visit; distributing per conjunct would have duplicated the duration measure. Everything else — the Past-wrapped appositive typing atoms, `(For l_paul_bremer iraq)`, `(Measure sk_visit_1 duration 2 hour)`, and the distributed `northern` on each named city — is left untouched.
